testcase.name: Scenario: Pin and unpin a recent document card: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:131:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Pin and unpin a recent document card ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And an unpinned recent part is displayed in Grid View ✔ When the user hovers over the part's card ✔ Then a Pin control appears on the card ✔ When the user activates Pin ✔ Then the control offers Unpin ✔ And the part remains in the recent grid ✔ When the user activates Unpin ✔ Then the control offers Pin again ✔ And the part remains in the recent grid
